townRating.rationale: One star is retained. Torphichen Preceptory is nationally important and a genuine specialist detour, but it is a short seasonal visit supported by one modest village wander and limited food and practical infrastructure. Nearby Bathgate Hills attractions are outside the town boundary and were not used to raise the rating.

boundaryRule: The official NRS 2022 Torphichen locality is preserved unchanged and used as the active visitor boundary. Every public planner marker is inside it. Nearby countryside attractions are excluded even when Visit West Lothian markets them under Torphichen.
